inj.note: Moton fractured his fibula in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday. The offensive tackle will likely miss the rest of the 2026 season due to the injury, making the move to injured reserve a formality. Monroe Freeling is set to start at right tackle for the Panthers for the remainder of the season.
inj.label: Out for season

news.h: Panthers RT Taylor Moton to undergo season-ending ankle surgery
news.d: Panthers right tackle Taylor Moton will undergo season-ending ankle surgery while also recovering from a fractured fibula in his left leg.
